behaviors.behavior: FR-01.02/AC02: an FR judged too broad is divided, but the judgement itself stays human (I6 advisory)
FR-01.02/AC03,AC04: every capability the person described is present in the catalogue, and nothing is invented beyond what was asked for
behaviors.reason: an interview-to-catalogue completeness/no-invention cross-check is an agent judgement call made live during an interactive elicitation session (comparing free-form natural language against a written catalogue); no doc anywhere instructs a coded gate for it and no coded gate exists to exercise -- same class as t5s AC02/AC05/AC08/AC11/AC12 grouping (trg-704cdb22 covers the unresolved-root question for AC01/AC15 only; this pair has no seam in ANY root)

behaviors.behavior: FR-01.02/AC05: every Must-priority FR has acceptance criteria before it is considered finished
FR-01.02/AC06: a bare assumed Basis cell with no paired acceptance criterion is rejected
FR-01.02/AC07,FR-01.16/AC01: every one of the six/seven grill-trace context dimensions must be answered, assumed, or n/a -- a blank dimension is a STOP
FR-01.02/AC08: an acceptance criterion containing a file path, ADR reference, or code symbol is rejected as implementation detail
FR-01.02/AC09: FRs are stated in plain business language a product owner can read, never dropping a guarantee
FR-01.02/AC10: every glossary term used is declared, and every declared delta term is actually used
FR-01.02/AC11: a hard-to-reverse choice has its rationale captured and linked back from the requirement it drove; an ADR must exist at all
FR-01.02/AC12: assumptions are surfaced before clarifying questions are asked
FR-01.02/AC13: a split with zero active FR rows is rejected, and a multi-row split must still be a cohesive purpose
FR-01.02/AC14: CLAUDE.md and the three starting agent_docs files exist and are non-empty
FR-01.02/AC01,AC15: a catalogue of individually deliverable requirements with starting guidance exists; a retired FR number stays permanently taken
behaviors.reason: already pinned by pre-existing tests outside this unit's two declared ADR-044 roots: plugins/shipwright-run/tests/test_phase_validators_project.py::test_legacy_pre_12_1_gate_still_fires, ::test_full_canon_project_passes (AC01 non-empty-catalogue gate); plugins/shipwright-compliance/tests::test_retired_fr_number_must_not_be_reused (AC15 retired-number-stays-taken clause). Adding a covers tag to those files would be self-authorizing a 3rd/4th root beyond this unit's declared scope; flagged unresolved as trg-704cdb22 for campaign-owner ratification, mirroring t5 Exception-3 precedent

behaviors.behavior: FR-01.16/AC02: the shared elicitation method's sections exist, and every elicitation surface (project/adopt/iterate) actually cites it
FR-01.16/AC03: the elicitation order is load-bearing (Sec 0)
FR-01.16/AC04: a used term triggers a glossary cross-check (Sec 4)
FR-01.16/AC05: at least two scenarios are required per requirement (Sec 5)
FR-01.16/AC06: the rationale behind a hard-to-reverse choice is captured at the moment it is decided, devoid of implementation detail (Sec 7)
FR-01.16/AC07: assumed is reserved for genuinely unobtainable answers; every dimension is still answered/assumed/n-a
FR-01.16/AC08: work does not proceed until the requirement is confirmed as a shared understanding (Sec 9)
FR-01.16/AC09: the set of elicitation-citing surfaces is discovered dynamically, not a hand-maintained list
FR-01.16/AC10: the method's enforced/prompt-only disclaimer rests on a real three-way verdict framework (Sec 6)
